Ah. Thanks for the detective work.

As a fix, you could use a text editor and global search and replace "+
with " +

(put a space between the quotes and the plusses).

I tried the excel "I'm not a formula" trick of starting with a single
quote (using "'+ as the replacement string), but Excel imported that
verbatim -- not the worst thing, but still not as clean as it should
be).
